description: Create mobile-first navigation system with fixed bottom nav bar and redesign Header/Footer components for mobile optimization. Add Noto Sans Devanagari font for Marathi content and mobile-first base styles. Depends on FEAT-001 for UI components.
steps: 1. Add Noto Sans Devanagari Google Font import to src/index.css (add @import url at top before @import tailwindcss)
2. Update @theme block in src/index.css to add --font-marathi: 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif token
3. Add mobile-first base styles to src/index.css after @theme: html { font-size: 16px; } button, a[role='button'] { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; } for touch targets

4. Create src/components/MobileNav.tsx: fixed bottom navigation bar (fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50) with 5 tabs using lucide-react icons: Home (Home), About (Users), Facilities (Building), Contact (Mail), Admission (GraduationCap). Active tab highlighted with primary color. Only show when currentRoute !== 'admin'. Use sheet component from FEAT-001 if needed for overflow.

5. Redesign src/components/Header.tsx: Mobile = compact horizontal layout with logo image imported from '../../assets/logo.png' (w-10 h-10), school name (ZPPS SRP CAMP in English + जि.प.प्रा.शाळा एस.आर.पी. कॅम्प in smaller Marathi below), hamburger menu button. Desktop = full horizontal nav as currently exists. Make sticky with backdrop-blur. Use Sheet component from FEAT-001 for mobile menu drawer sliding from left.

6. Redesign src/components/Footer.tsx: Stack sections vertically on mobile (flex-col md:flex-row). Add click-to-call tel: links for phone numbers (<a href='tel:+919876543210'>), click-to-email mailto: links (<a href='mailto:admin@zppssrrcamp.edu.in'>). Add WhatsApp link with WhatsApp icon from lucide-react. Keep existing content but optimize layout for mobile.

7. Update src/App.tsx: Add MobileNav component below main element, before Footer. Pass currentRoute and navigate props. Conditionally render: {currentRoute !== 'admin' && <MobileNav currentRoute={currentRoute} navigate={navigate} />}
8. Add padding-bottom (pb-20 md:pb-0) to main element in App.tsx to prevent content from being hidden behind fixed bottom nav on mobile
acceptance_criteria: Noto Sans Devanagari font loads successfully and displays Marathi text correctly
MobileNav appears as fixed bottom bar on mobile viewports (<768px), hidden on desktop
MobileNav has 5 working tabs with icons, active state highlights in primary color
MobileNav does NOT appear on admin route
Header shows compact mobile layout with logo image (not icon), bilingual school name, working hamburger menu
Header hamburger opens Sheet drawer from left with navigation links
Header shows full desktop nav on larger screens (>=768px)
Footer phone numbers are clickable tel: links, email is clickable mailto: link
Footer includes WhatsApp link with icon
All interactive elements meet 44px minimum touch target on mobile
verification: Expected: Build succeeds with no errors, logo.png imported successfully
Expected: Dev server starts on port 3000
Manual test in browser DevTools mobile viewport (375px width):
- Verify MobileNav appears at bottom with 5 visible tabs
- Tap each tab and verify navigation works
- Verify MobileNav disappears when navigating to admin route
- Tap hamburger in Header and verify Sheet drawer slides in from left
- Verify logo image displays in Header
- Tap phone number in Footer and verify tel: protocol link
- Verify all tap targets are easily clickable (44x44px minimum)
findings: All steps completed successfully. Created MobileNav component with 5 tabs (Home, About, Facilities, Contact, Admission) that appears fixed at bottom on mobile (<768px) and hides on admin route. Redesigned Header with logo image import (zpps-logo.png), bilingual school name (English + Marathi), and Sheet drawer sliding from left for mobile menu. Updated Footer with clickable tel:, mailto:, and WhatsApp links. Added Noto Sans Devanagari font for Marathi content. Enhanced Sheet component to support side variants (left/right/bottom). Added pb-20 md:pb-0 to main element to prevent bottom nav overlap. Created src/vite-env.d.ts for TypeScript image import declarations. Build and lint pass without errors. Logo file was named zpps-logo.png (not logo.png as documented). Manual testing needed: verify mobile viewport behavior at 375px width, test hamburger menu Sheet animation, verify MobileNav tab navigation, test clickable contact links in Footer.
